title: NEET-UG 2026 case: CBI links leak to teachers who set paper, did translation work
content: In a shocking revelation, subject experts are accused of memorizing and leaking NEET-UG 2026 exam questions after receiving daily access from home. These reconstructed queries found their way into private coaching classes, with a beautician reportedly formatting them for sale. The scheme's spread across multiple states is now under scrutiny, leading the CBI to file a chargesheet against thirteen individuals implicated in this alleged scam.

title: 'How is unelected minister continuing for over six months?' SC raps Bihar govt
content: The Supreme Court questioned the Bihar government regarding a minister's continued service.  This minister has served beyond the six-month constitutional limit without legislative election.  The court seeks an explanation for this continuation under Article 164(4) of the Constitution.  A petition challenges the minister's reappointment after a government change.  The court referenced a prior judgment on similar constitutional provisions.

title: Big relief for CJP protesters: Delhi govt drops cases, but there's a key condition
content: In a significant decision, the Delhi government will not take further legal steps against the majority of protesters from the July 20 'Chalo Sansad' march. This brings a sense of relief to many who were involved. Authorities are moving swiftly to review and potentially release detained individuals, though exceptions apply for those with prior criminal records, with police noting over 2,800 such individuals connected to the protests.

title: Former captains slam saffron hockey jersey: 'India's identity has always been blue'
content: ​​"Everything in the country is being saffronised," said former India captain Pargat Singh while criticizing Hockey India's decision.

title: NYC banned Motoclick, now Mamdani targets Uber Eats, DoorDash over "hidden" tip buttons
content: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says the city's crackdown on Uber Eats and DoorDash tipping practices has delivered $104 million in extra tips to delivery workers since January. A new DCWP report shows tips per delivery doubled from $1.18 to $2.29 after apps were forced to show tip buttons at checkout. Mamdani, who earlier moved to shut down Motoclick, warns more enforcement is coming.

title: US signs $58.6bn mega deal for Patriot missiles as stock runs low amid Iran war
content: The United States awarded Lockheed Martin a significant contract for Patriot interceptor missiles. This deal ensures long-term production of crucial air defence interceptors for the US Army.  Concerns over dwindling missile stockpiles influenced this major procurement decision.  The agreement aims to triple production capacity and boost employment at a key facility.  This expansion supports broader Pentagon efforts to accelerate weapons manufacturing globally.

title: Mumbai's Rs 10 crore-plus home market scales a record Rs 18,512 crore in H1 2026
content: Mumbai's luxury housing market recorded its highest half-yearly transaction value in 2026. Buyers spent Rs 18,512 crore on homes priced at Rs 10 crore and above. This segment saw a 12% growth over the previous year's performance. Established areas like Worli led sales, registering a significant increase in value. Demand remains strong, particularly for homes in the Rs 20-40 crore range.

title: Kevin O'Leary says China's rise will unite US, Canada and Mexico
content: Kevin O'Leary suggests China's growing power will unite North American economies.  Canada offers minerals and energy, while the US provides scale and innovation.  Mexico also plays a vital role in the regional economic landscape.  Companies are increasingly using cheaper Chinese artificial intelligence models.  This shift occurs as the race for technological dominance accelerates globally.

title: The 'fire-breathing dragon of clouds' over France: When a wildfire creates its own weather
content: France has recorded its first known 'fire cloud' as extreme wildfires sweep across Europe. Also called a pyrocumulonimbus, the towering storm forms when intense heat pushes smoke, air and moisture high into the atmosphere. It can generate powerful winds, lightning and fresh fires, allowing a wildfire to influence, and sometimes create, its own weather.

title: China gained 447,500 sq km of planted forest but lost vast natural cover
content: China's large-scale tree planting programmes helped increase overall forest cover over three decades, but a new study says they also coincided with growing fragmentation of natural forests. Researchers found plantations often expanded near natural forest edges, breaking up connected habitats. The study also found China's Natural Forest Protection Program helped slow this fragmentation in protected areas.

title: Three 911 calls failed after California woman was bitten by rattlesnake
content: A Californian woman experienced a rattlesnake bite during her gardening routine, highlighting the perils of nature. Unfortunately, her attempts to reach out for help via 911 were met with failure, prompting her husband to drive her to the nearest hospital swiftly. Experts reveal an increase in venomous snake incidents statewide, urging the public to stay composed and obtain timely medical care in the aftermath of bites.

title: Days after resigning citing stress, Thinking Machines' Lilian Weng rejoins OpenAI
content: Lilian Weng rejoined OpenAI after a brief resignation from Thinking Machines Lab. She cited stress and illness as reasons for her initial departure. Weng will now work alongside Sam Altman in a more predictable role. This move follows other AI leaders stepping back due to health issues. Talent continues to move between major influential players in the AI field.

title: Joint property ownership: What happens when co-owners disagree over rent or sale
content: A growing number of buyers are opting for shared homeownership to alleviate financial strain and share loan obligations. In various states, including a woman as a co-owner can unlock potential stamp duty reductions. However, this arrangement necessitates mutual consent for the sale of the property and any loan matters, with each co-owner entitled to sell their respective portion. Disputes between co-owners can result in negotiations, buyouts, or legal partitions.

title: Govt summons Meta again over temporary restriction of PM Modi's FB post
content: India's government has summoned Meta executives to explain a temporary restriction on Prime Minister Modi's video. The social media giant acknowledged the error and has restored the content. New protocols are being introduced for prominent public figures' accounts. This incident highlights ongoing scrutiny of content moderation by tech firms. The government seeks explanations for platform governance and content handling.

title: Watch: UP cop snatches Kangana Ranaut effigy, runs as Congress workers chase
content: During a recent Congress protest highlighting concerns about remarks made by Kangana Ranaut regarding women, a police inspector intervened dramatically. He swiftly seized an effigy of the actress to prevent it from being set on fire by agitated protesters. The incident, centered around allegations of disrespect toward young women, has sparked a flurry of discussions online, with videos of the event going viral.

title: 'Composure isn't the opposite of aggression': Sachin's heartfelt tribute to Rahane
content: Ajinkya Rahane announced his retirement from international cricket on Thursday.  Sachin Tendulkar led tributes, recalling Rahane's dedication and leadership qualities.  Former coach Ravi Shastri praised his yeoman service to Indian cricket.  Cheteshwar Pujara and Virender Sehwag also celebrated his career achievements.  Rahane retires with 5,077 Test runs and an unbeaten captaincy record.

title: Chennai court sentences Chhota Rajan to seven years' imprisonment in fake passport case
content: The CBI court convicted Rajan under charges of cheating, forgery, cheating by personation and knowingly submitting forged documents to obtain a passport.

title: EPA expands electricity bill pledge signed by Google, Meta and Amazon
content: Tech giants pledge to cover energy costs for their facilities.  The Environmental Protection Agency expanded this pledge to include utilities and regulators.  New guidance exempts data centers not connected to the public grid from certain regulations.  This move aims to support artificial intelligence infrastructure development.  It also seeks to prevent higher electricity bills for American households.

title: From ayurveda to finance: Patanjali gets IRDAI nod for Rs 4.5Kcr insurance entry
content: Patanjali Ayurved is set to enter financial services after IRDAI approved its nearly Rs 4,500 crore acquisition of Magma General Insurance.

title: UP horror: Landlord 'rapes' tenant's minor daughter repeatedly, records videos
content: Police reported a 10-year-old girl was allegedly raped by her landlord in Goverdhan. The accused, a 42-year-old West Bengal native, had assaulted the minor previously. The victim informed her mother after the incident on Wednesday. Police registered a case under BNS and POCSO sections. The girl has undergone medical examination and further legal action is pending.

title: Fleming takes over as England Test coach; ex-CSK boss begins new era with Root
content: Stephen Fleming has been appointed as England men's Test head coach. He replaces Brendon McCullum and will begin his tenure later this summer. Marcus Trescothick will serve as interim coach for the Pakistan series. Fleming expressed excitement about working with returning captain Joe Root. The new partnership aims to rebuild England's red-ball cricket fortunes.

title: E20 petrol can reduce vehicle mileage by up to 6%: Nitin Gadkari in Parliament
content: E20 petrol may reduce vehicle mileage by two to six percent. Extensive testing has found no engine failures linked to this fuel. Studies indicate improved acceleration and better ride quality with E20. Carbon emissions are reduced by approximately thirty percent compared to E10. Automobile manufacturers continue to honor warranty claims for vehicles using E20.

title: Kirti Kulhari loses Rs 2.4 lakh to cyber fraud; files complaint
content: In a shocking turn of events, Kirti Kulhari, the talented actress, encountered cyber fraud in Mumbai. Unidentified criminals infiltrated her mobile phone and credit card, executing unauthorized transactions that totaled Rs 243,852 in mere minutes. Disturbed by this breach, Kulhari promptly reported the incident to the police, prompting the Cyber Cell to launch an investigation. The incident happened while she enjoyed a show at a theatre in Andheri West.

title: Denied seat, student hacks IIT-Kanpur website to show his 'merit'
content: A BTech applicant hacked IIT Kanpur's website seeking admission consideration. He claimed he was denied a fair chance in the selection process. The IIT director invited the candidate to campus for an assessment. He stressed that hacking was not the correct approach to gain entry. The institute will consider him if genuine talent is demonstrated.

title: Who was Billy Ray Smith Jr? Chargers legend dies at 64 after remarkable career
content: Billy Ray Smith Jr., the former San Diego Chargers linebacker and College Football Hall of Famer, died at 64 after struggling with dementia caused by CTE. Here's everything to know about his life, from his childhood in Arkansas and standout college career to his decade in the NFL, his broadcasting journey, his wife, Kimberly Hunt, his family, and his lasting football legacy. The Chargers legend spent his entire professional career with the franchise and remained a respected voice in sports long after retirement.

title: Neeraj Chopra leads full Indian charge into javelin final; Rohit, Yash Vir qualify
content: Neeraj Chopra and two other Indian javelin throwers advanced to the medal round.  Rohit Yadav and Yash Vir Singh also secured their spots in the final contest.  Chopra focused on qualifying while managing his recovery from injury.  Difficult weather conditions affected all competitors during the qualification event.  The Indian contingent aims for podium finishes in the upcoming final.

title: Inside Villa Skyfall: James Bond-inspired $85 million Florida mansion hits the market
content: Introducing Villa Skyfall, an extraordinary mansion inspired by James Bond, available for a staggering $85 million. Nestled in the prestigious Stone Creek Ranch of Delray Beach, Florida, this opulent estate boasts nine luxurious bedrooms, an elegant grand salon adorned with crystal chandeliers, and even a concealed poker lounge. With its rainforest-inspired spa and included furnishings, buyers can experience immediate luxury living.

title: Beyond the cargo bay: The rise of transport aircraft as battlefield, rescue assets
content: Transport aircraft now perform diverse roles beyond basic cargo delivery.  These versatile platforms are crucial for combat and humanitarian relief operations.  Modern aircraft like the C-130 and C-390 offer multi-mission flexibility.  The Airbus A400M Atlas also bridges strategic and tactical capabilities effectively.  These adaptable aircraft serve as significant force multipliers in various scenarios.

title: Coimbatore car bomb blast case: ED conducts searches in 4 cities to trace source funding
content: ED recently took over the investigation to probe the source of funding for radicalisation and terror activities.

title: Why Indian hockey team jersey changed from blue to saffron: HI explains
content: Hockey India will use saffron jerseys for the 2026 World Cup. According to Hockey India, the traditional blue jersey blended with the blue artificial turf used in international hockey, making it difficult for players to spot teammates during matches. The federation said players and coaches suggested different colours before saffron was chosen.

title: TMC's Kalyan Banerjee wears poster with 20 rebel MPs' photos in Parliament
content: Trinamool Congress MP Kalyan Banerjee protested against 20 rebel MPs in Parliament. These defectors joined the Nationalist Citizens Party of India, pledging support to the NDA. The Trinamool Congress has labeled these MPs as traitors for their actions. Rebel MPs had approached the Election Commission regarding the party split. A swift decision is needed to resolve the ongoing political uncertainty.

title: Raghav Juyal opens up on 'Bhai Tera Star Hai', Govinda | Exclusive
content: Raghav Juyal discusses his new film, Bhai Tera Star Hai, and its comedic appeal. He feels the film fills a gap for lighthearted entertainment. Juyal notes a shift in industry perception after his role in the film Kill. He aims to offer audiences a dose of happiness through his comedy projects. Juyal also shares his views on being a protector and provider for women.

title: Why a chicken biryani demand for Tamil Nadu schools is making headlines across India
content: In Tamil Nadu, the noon-meal initiative is exploring the addition of chicken biryani to its menu, reflecting an evolution in its commitment to student welfare. Teachers have also addressed unresolved issues related to employment conditions and salaries. Furthermore, the government intends to digitize petition tracking, underscoring the growing importance of school meals in shaping education policy and ensuring accountability.

title: Bengaluru has water reserves for only 4 months
content: Bengaluru's water supply is secure for the next four months. Reservoir storage levels are sufficient to meet the city's monthly water needs. Officials are monitoring groundwater and seeking reports on its status. Residents are urged to conserve water and avoid non-essential uses. Treated water should not be used for gardening or washing doorsteps.

title: From delivery rider to Rs 1 crore entrepreneur: How one accident changed his life
content: After financial hardship forced him to pause his medical studies, Ajit Kumar worked as a food delivery rider, cycling up to 100 kilometres daily to support his family. A serious road accident ended his delivery career but led him to discover writing through Pocket FM. Today, he is the lead writer of the hit audio-fiction series Brahmyodha: The Destroyer, has written over 1,000 episodes, and reportedly earned more than ₹1 crore through digital storytelling.

title: Will AI take your job? Cashiers to doctors, which professions face biggest risk
content: Artificial intelligence will automate routine jobs across many industries.  Complex tasks requiring human judgment will be supported by generative AI.  Financial services and retail trade see high automation risk for basic operations.  Healthcare and education will see AI strengthen clinical and learning roles.  Workplace tasks will be reshaped as AI complements human capabilities.

title: BJP MP Anurag Thakur files privilege notice against Rahul Gandhi over remarks on Amit Shah
content: The Leader of the Opposition in the Lok Sabha had alleged that the Home Minister had authorised police excesses against student protesters and that the RSS had “captured” the education system

title: Contract staff seek ₹26,000 monthly minimum wage
content: Thousands of workers stage protest in Ongole, demand government to immediately revise minimum wages pending since 2009

title: Ashok slams State govt. over its failure to respond to drought situation in Karnataka, demands immediate relief for farmers
content: BJP to launch padayatra from Anjanadri Hill to Tungabhadra Dam on Friday demanding water release for irrigation

title: State to kick-start sale of rice at subsidised rates from August 1 in Kakinada district
content: Super BPT Stream and raw rice varieties will be sold at Rythu Bazaars under the Market Intervention Programme to tackle rising rice prices in the State.

title: Bengaluru: Student part of Freedom Park protest assaulted; FIR registered
content: AISA alleged that the attackers asked why the victim demanded PM Narendra Modi’s resignation, before assaulting him

title: Malayalam filmmaker Bharathan remembered in his native place in Kerala’s Wadakkancherry with music, memories and tributes
content: Screenwriter Shibu Chakravarthy recalls filmmaker’s enduring legacy; KPAC Lalitha also honoured at Wadakkanchery event

title: Farmers demand reciprocal visit by Karnataka CM to delta districts
content: P.R. Pandian, president of Coordination Committee of All Farmers’ Associations of Tamil Nadu, has urged Tamil Nadu Chief Minister to take his Karnataka counterpart on an aerial visit of delta districts

title: Pier anglers in Kerala’s Thiruvananthapuram await restoration of Valiyathura Pier
content: Gilbert Raju, a 42-year-old orally challenged fisherman, is among the many awaiting government reconstruction of the heritage structure to continue using it to reel in fish

title: Tumakuru-Shivamogga NH-69 four-laning project nearing completion, final package due by March 2027
content: In a written reply to an unstarred question by B.Y. Raghavendra, Shivamogga MP, in the Lok Sabha on Thursday (July 30), Union Road Transport and Highways Minister Nitin Gadkari said that the four-laning project has been taken up under four packages based on the Hybrid Annuity Model.

title: Cultural academies in Kerala must become more people-centric, says Minister Vishnunadh
content: Minister promises early appointment of governing bodies, revival of Koothambalam, uninterrupted ITFoK funding and stronger support for Kerala’s cultural institutions

title: Officials call for stronger fight against human, child trafficking
content: Markapuram Collector unveils a special campaign poster designed by the representatives of voluntary organisation ‘Vetti Vimochana Coalition Network’, while Prakasam Joint Collector Kalpana Kumari flags off an awareness rally from from Prakasam Bhavan to Ongole RIMS on the occasion World Day against Trafficking in Persons

title: Expert panel recommends El Nino mitigation measures with ₹803 crore to Telangana government
content: Committee recommends to government to issue a directive to private educational institutions against insisting on immediate fee payment from drought-hit farmers’ families

title: Karnataka government to upgrade Aadhaar authentication security infrastructure
content: The scheduled software upgrade will incorporate the latest security patches, bug fixes and OEM-supported enhancements to improve overall system performance

title: Tushar Gandhi urges Kerala to quash cases filed against student protesters
content: In a letter addressed to Chief Minister V.D. Satheesan and Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala, he says it’s disgraceful students are being prosecuted in Kerala, where a Congress-led government is in power.

title: 'Sheikh Hasina Will Be Arrested The Moment She Returns': Bangladesh Minister
content: Bangladesh Law Minister M Asaduzzaman asserted that Hasina, who was sentenced to death in November 2025, may not even get the chance to surrender directly to a court before getting arrested.

title: Thane Man Stabs Son To Death After He Tried To Save Mother During Fight
content: The incident took place at Uttan on the night of July 26, senior inspector Subhashchandra N Markad of the Uttan Sagari police station under the Mira Bhayandar-Vasai Virar (MBVV) police commissionerate said.

title: Gangster Chota Rajan Gets 7 Years In Jail In Passport Forgery Case
content: The agency began its probe on March 19, 2002, after registering an FIR on the allegations that the accused applied for and obtained a passport by submitting forged documents, thereby cheating the Regional Passport Office, Chennai.

title: 4 Killed From Israeli Strikes Amid Ongoing Ceasefire, Says Gaza Ministry
content: A ceasefire remains in place between Israel and Palestinian group Hamas, but it has not halted the violence in Gaza, and efforts to secure a lasting agreement to end the war have stalled.

title: High Alert In 13 Gujarat Districts As Weather Office Predicts Heavy Rain
content: The measures were reviewed at a comprehensive meeting chaired by Additional Chief Secretary (Revenue) Dr Jayanti Ravi at the State Emergency Operation Centre (SEOC) in Gandhinagar.

title: No Legal Action Against CJP Protesters In Delhi, Arrests To Be Reviewed
content: The Delhi government has said no adverse legal action will be taken against people booked over protests linked to alleged NEET-UG irregularities.

title: Russia Likely Used North Korean Missile In Deadly Ukraine Strike: Report
content: A Russian overnight attack that killed a family near the Ukrainian city of Kryvyi Rih likely used a North Korean missile, two sources said, in what would be the first time such a weapon had been fired in the war in nearly a year.

title: Lok Sabha Clears Bill To Criminalise Insult To Vande Mataram
content: The Prevention of Insults to National Honour Act currently prohibits intentionally preventing the singing of the national anthem (Jana Gana Mana), or causing disturbance to any assembly engaged in such singing.

title: "Technology Delayed Is Technology Denied": Air Force Chief Pushes For Self-Reliance
content: "We should be able to have no fratricide, in terms of we shooting down our own drones or taking down something that is meant for us," he said.

title: Pune Marathon Runner Dies In Crash, Family Donates Organs To Save 4 Lives
content: Uday Birmal sustained severe head injuries after he was hit by an out-of-control auto-rickshaw while practicing for a marathon on the morning of July 19.

title: 215 Academics Slam Priyanka Gandhi's 'Cow Urine' Remark On IIT Professor
content: "To dismiss a scholar through a label rather than engage with the substance of his views risks undermining the very scientific temper that our Constitution calls upon every citizen to develop," the open letter said

title: NDTV Impact: J&K Pellet Victim Who Lost Eyesight In 2016 Gets Compensation
content: Insha Mushtaq is often remembered as the face of 'pellet horror' in Jammu and Kashmir. At 14, she was struck by a barrage of pellets that permanently blinded her.

title: Muslims Can Offer Friday Prayers At Dargah Near Bhojshala Complex: Supreme Court
content: The bench directed the Madhya Pradesh government to ensure that Muslims are allowed to offer prayers at the site between 1 pm and 3 pm on Fridays.

title: J&K School Points To "Copy-Paste" Error On "No Bindi, Tilak, Kalava" Rule
content: Acknowledging the sensitivity of the matter, Chief Education Officer, Poonch, Javed Iqbal Gulshan summoned the school principal for an explanation.

title: Delhi MBA Graduate, On The Run For 2 Years, Arrested For Rape And Blackmail
content: The Delhi Police Crime Branch has arrested a man accused of raping a woman at gunpoint, recording explicit photos and videos of her, and allegedly blackmailing and sexually exploiting her over a prolonged period by threatening to make the material public.

title: 25 Cats Rescued After Explosion Following Japan Earthquake
content: After a 7.1 quake hit the Aeon mall, staff evacuated Cat Cafe MOFF. They returned to save the cats, but a gas explosion forced another exit.

title: Karnataka High Court notice to State on plea to declare Mullayyanagiri Hills areas ‘conservation reserve’
content: The High Court of Karnataka ordered issue of notice to the State government on a PIL petition seeking direction to the government to declare the entire extent of ecologically fragile Mullayyanagiri Hills in Chikkamagaluru district as a ‘conservation reserve’ under Section 36A of the Wild Life (Protection) Act, 1972

title: Varayattumudy in Kerala’s Idukki emerging a thriving habitat of Nilgiri tahrs
content: The Nilgiri tahr population on the hills has risen significantly, with nearly 150 tahrs recently sighted, up from around 50 in 2022. Forest dept. completes eco-restoration project across 22.5 hectares, ensuring better food availability for the animals

title: Man ‘working in Australia’ for two years found buried in Jamnagar; wife, two others held
content: As the woman did not provide her husband’s Australian address despite repeated requests, the family of his cousin who wanted to go to Australia grew suspicious and registered a police complaint.

title: 254 dilapidated and neglected temples in Tamil Nadu identified for restoration
content: “While major, well-known temples usually receive greater attention, we are prioritising small, neglected ancient temples of historical significance that have fallen into severe ruin,” Minister Ramesh told The Hindu

title: July 31 enrolment deadline triggers last-minute rush for crop insurance scheme
content: Officials of the Agriculture and Horticulture departments have stepped up last-minute efforts to enrol as many farmers as possible under the insurance scheme in Sri Sathya Sai, Chittoor and Annamayya districts, which are historically known for their dependence on the monsoons

title: SHRC orders strict enforcement of rules for protection of mangroves, wetlands in Kannur
content: SHRC directs the Collector and the Principal Chief Conservator of Forests to coordinate with departments to ensure effective protection of mangroves, wetlands and riverbank ecosystems in the district

title: Bhogapuram airport commute: ₹300 by RTC e-bus, ₹800 to ₹1,500 by cab from Visakhapatnam
content: The Hindu drove 43 km from Visakhapatnam in 75 minutes; at 4.30 p.m. fares of ride-aggregators were checked

title: KGMOA, IMA condemn attempted assault on doctor in Kerala’s Attingal
content: Medical officers’ forum alleges that Attingal municipal chairperson unnecessarily intervened in the functioning of the hospital’s emergency department, obstructed the doctor’s official duties, and issued him death threats
